reviewItem.question: Does "Storage version of `clusterexternalsecrets.external-secrets.io` changes v1beta1 → v1" mean a change to migration:external-secrets|name=clusterexternalsecret-storage-version-migration (migration-required)?

proposed.statement: The storage version of the clusterexternalsecrets.external-secrets.io CRD moves from v1beta1 to v1 (v1beta1 storage true → false); existing objects stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten, so a storage version migration is needed before a later release removes v1beta1.
